given: the stock table lists stock records that carry a batch_number and a serial_number
when: the operator views the stock table
then: each row presents batch and serial as two distinct, individually labeled fields, and the former combined inventory_code is no longer shown anywhere in the table
architectural_notes: Client-to-server contract: the React SPA stock-table page fetches stock records from the JSON boundary (app/routes) and renders batch_number and serial_number as two distinct labeled columns, dropping the combined inventory_code. Only a real Playwright e2e against the live API verifies the client parses the actual response envelope (split fields, no inventory_code) and renders it — a mocked component test would let a fabricated shape pass green. No new business logic or persistence; reuses the F1 boundary->service->repository->models layering (NFR-R5 SPA/JSON boundary).
